interpretation: These two counts describe different projections. Complete parity is determined from the pinned source contracts plus actual tools/list for each supported mode and provider combination, not from either count alone.
runtimeAuthority: The live, authenticated, revisioned Host Agent catalog for the selected mode and active providers.
npmPublication: Postponed (owner, 2026-11-02): the v0.2.4 tag and GitHub release exist, npm still lists 0.2.3. The parity journeys pack the launcher from the pinned tree and use a local release base, so none reads the npm registry.
sourceReleaseRebuild: The GitHub release v0.2.4 assets are the installed artifacts (SHA256SUMS above). The harness rebuilds Go's release set from a git-archive export of the pinned tree (M10), so its bytes differ from the release: Go stamps the module version and vcs.* settings only when building from a git checkout, and records the build directory. The build flags, toolchain and dependencies are the same.
